questionText:

In an urban corporate wellness study, 60 sedentary executive employees suffering from Stage 1 essential hypertension and obesity (average BMI 31.8 kg/m²) participated in a 12-week supervised yogic intervention. The protocol prohibited high-speed dynamic movements and rapid breath holds. Participants performed Tadasana, Katichakrasana, and Pavanmuktasana to stimulate abdominal peristalsis and lipid metabolism. questionText: In a 'Double Knockout' tournament, a team is eliminated only after:

options.text: Losing a single game in round one

detailedSolution:

Suffering two defeats in the tournament

Double knockout ensures that every competitor must lose twice before being eliminated from championship contention.
Hence, Option C is correct.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the obesity-correcting asana in List I with its primary contraindication in List II:

List I:
(A) Vajrasana
(B) Hastottanasana
(C) Trikonasana
(D) Ardha Matsyendrasana

List II:
(I) Severe knee injury or recent knee ligament surgery
(II) Severe vertigo or serious cervical spine spondylitis
(III) Severe slipped disc, acute sciatica, or recent abdominal surgery
(IV) Pregnancy (beyond 1st trimester) and acute peptic ulcers

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Vajrasana contraindicates knee issues; Hastottanasana contraindicates vertigo; Trikonasana contraindicates slipped disc/sciatica; Ardha Matsyendrasana contraindicates pregnancy/ulcers.
Hence, Option D is correct.
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
